# uptrace_incidentio_channel (Resource)

Manages an Uptrace incident.io notification channel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptrace_org" "example" {
  name = "My Organization"
}

resource "uptrace_project" "example" {
  org_id = uptrace_org.example.id
  name   = "api"
}

resource "uptrace_incidentio_channel" "example" {
  project_id = uptrace_project.example.id
  name       = "alerts-incidentio"
  priorities = ["high"]
  url        = "https://api.incident.io/v2/alert_events/..."
  api_key    = "your-incidentio-api-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) incident.io API key.
- `name` (String) Human-readable channel name.
- `priorities` (List of String) Alert priorities to match. Valid values: info, low, medium, high.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID this channel belongs to. Changing this forces recreation.
- `url` (String) Alert Events V2 endpoint URL.

### Optional

- `condition` (String) Alert condition expression.
- `match_all` (Boolean) Match all monitors. If false, monitor_ids must be provided.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) Monitor IDs to match when match_all is false.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Channel ID.
- `status` (String) Channel status (delivering, paused, disabled, draft).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uptrace_incidentio_channel.example 1:42
```
